items.description: The impact's distinguishing claim that the event from address equals the caller (msg.sender) rather than the debited holder is not separately encoded; the relation only requires event_from_address == debited_holder_address, and the misattribution to caller_address is captured only via the impact citation.

Report does not give a numeric or structural definition linking event fields to reconstructed balances; correctness of reconstruction is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a computed balance equation.
Report does not give a numeric or structural definition linking the emitted event field to the debited holder beyond the stated identity; binding is deferred to code.
